senses.gloss: भिद् [cf. Lat. findo; Germ. beissen; Eng. bite.]
2. भि॑द् mfn. (ifc.) breaking, splitting, piercing, destroying, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pur. (cf. अश्म-, गिरि-, तमो-, पुर-भिद् &c.)
भि॑द् f. a wall (= भित्ति), RV. i, 174, 8
separation, distinction, BhP.
a sort, kind, species, L.
भिदक m. ‘cutter’ or ‘wounder’, a sword, L.
Indra's thunderbolt, L.
भिदथ m. an arrow, L.
भिदा f. splitting, bursting, destroying, destruction, Kāv. (cf. दुर्-भिद)
separation (see -भृत्)
distinction, difference, Kāv.; BhP.
a kind or species, Sāh.
coriander, L.
भिदा-कर mfn. causing a distinction, Kāvyād.
भिदा—भृत् mfn. ‘broken’ or ‘enduring separation’, Śiś. vi, 5.
भिदापन n. (from an irreg. Caus. भिदापय) causing to break or pound or trample on BhP.
भिदि m. a thunderbolt, Uṇ. iv, 142, Sch.
भिदिर n. id., ib. i, 52, Sch.
भिदु m. id., i, 24, Sch.
भिदुर mfn. (ifc.) breaking, splitting, piercing, destroying, Hcar.
easily split or broken, fragile, brittle, Mālatīm. (cf. Vām. v, 2, 60)
divided, variegated, mingled or mingling with, Śiś.
भिदुर m. a chain for an elephant's feet, L.
भिदुर n. a thunderbolt, Uṇ. i, 52, Sch.,
भिदुर—स्वन m. ‘making a piercing noise’, N. of an Asura, Hariv.
भिदेलिम mfn. easily broken, brittle, fragile, Sadukt. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 96, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
भिद्य m. a rushing river or N. of a r˚, Ragh.; Bhaṭṭ. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 1, 115)
भिद्य n. splitting, breaking, destroying (cf. पूर्-भि॑द्य and शीर्ष-भि॑द्य)
भिद्र n. a thunderbolt, Uṇ. ii, 13, Sch.
भिद्-वत् mfn. containing the √ भिद्, Kāṭh.
